messages:
marta: Morning handoff — quick note before I head out. System is green overall but a few items to watch during the morning window. TL;DR: embeddings latency pop, flaky e2e job, and a small Dedicated autoscale tweak.

ajay: Thanks — any recent deploys that could explain the embeddings tail?

marta: No user-facing model rollouts. We had a config tweak on the batching service at 04:12 UTC to reduce max batch wait; might be causing smaller batches and higher tail latency.

samir: Seeing the tail on metrics too — embeddings.kv_cache_hit dropped ~6% around 04:20 UTC, and p50 is fine but p95 jumped from 420ms -> 1.1s.

marta: Good catch. Action items: 1) ajay to take point on embeddings investigation for first 2hrs, 2) samir to prepare a temporary route cap if errors increase, 3) I'll follow up on the CI flakes.

ajay: I'll own embeddings until 10:30 PT. First step: check batching service logs + dequeue sizes. I'll post findings here.

oncall-bot: Alert suppressed: embeddings-route-high-tail (muted for 30m) — reason: investigating.

samir: If retry storms start, we should consider lowering retry budget on client-sdk for embeddings to avoid cascading. Can set rate-limit rule on the LB for 5m if needed.

marta: Noted. Samir — can you prep the LB rule snippet? If we need it, let's apply with a canary of 1% then 10%.

samir: Will do. Snippet below for applying a short-lived rule via infra CLI:

```bash
infra-cli lb add-rule --name reduce-emb-retries --route embeddings --limit 80rps --duration 5m --tags oncall
```

marta: CI situation — the e2e test suite started failing intermittently on the dedupe integration test after 03:50 UTC. Root cause looks like an async timeout in the test harness, not prod. I filed PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/4567 — reviewers: @devex, @ajay.

devex: On it, will review in the next 30. Also pinging @qa to re-run the failing job with increased timeouts.

ajay: I ran a quick local repro of the batching change — with the old config p95 is 380ms, new config moves it to ~900ms under the same synthetic load. Rolling back that tweak is an option if we see customer impact.

marta: Let's hold rollback unless we see errors. For now, prefer mitigation via LB rules + retry budget. If p95 exceeds 1.5s or error rate >0.25% for embeddings, we escalate to rollback.

ajay: Understood. I'll post a chart snapshot and a small runbook of checks within 15m.

marta: Other FYIs: Dedicated autoscaler bumped one pool (dp-gpu-3) to +1 replica at 05:00 UTC due to a short burst; no action needed. Also, Housekeeping: my pager window ends at 09:30 PT — @ajay you're on for the rest.

ajay: Taking the handoff. Will monitor dashboards and post updates. 

marta: Thanks — leaving a short checklist for you: 
- Check embeddings p95/p99 every 10m (dashboard link: https://console.redwood/dash/embeddings)
- Watch KV cache hit, batching.queue_length, and LB error rates
- If errors spike, apply LB rule (samir's snippet) and reduce retry budget
- Revert batching config only after approval from infra/eng-runtime

ajay: Got it. I'll update channel if anything changes. :thumbsup:

marta: End handoff — GLHF! :rocket:
